description: This file defines a client for making API requests to a backend server, including utility functions for building URLs, handling query parameters, and specific functions for listing users, sessions, deployments, and costs. It also provides a minimal axios-like interface and health check functions.

methods.name: isAbsoluteUrl
methods.description: Utility function to check if a URL is absolute (starts with http or https).

methods.name: buildUrl
methods.description: Constructs a full URL by joining base API URL with a given path or URL, handling edge cases like absolute URLs, relative paths, and paths starting with /api.

methods.name: toQuery
methods.description: Converts an object of parameters into a URL query string, handling arrays and objects appropriately.

methods.name: isSessionTrackingRoot
methods.description: Detects if the provided path is the root of session-tracking API endpoint.

methods.name: sanitizeEndpointParams
methods.description: Sanitizes query params for specific API endpoints, ensuring only allowed parameters are sent for e.g., /api/users and session-tracking root.

methods.name: ensureScopedQueryParams
methods.description: Adds necessary scoping parameters like organization_id or tenant_id based on the endpoint path.

methods.name: buildUrlWithParams
methods.description: Builds a URL with query parameters, merging with existing query string if present.

methods.name: parseResponse
methods.description: Parses fetch response, returning ok status, status code, and payload; handles JSON and text content types.

methods.name: httpGet
methods.description: Performs a GET request with URL building, parameter scoping, and error handling.

methods.name: httpJson
methods.description: Performs a JSON-based fetch request (POST, PUT, DELETE) with proper headers, URL, and error handling.

methods.name: normalizeListPayload
methods.description: Normalizes list responses into items array, total count, and meta information.
